title: The Bundle Share Taken Off an Equipment Rental and Demo Hire Rate
content:
Kit of the Equipment Rental and Demo line hired alongside something else the household has bought from the collective is hired at a bundle share off, and where both grounds stand only one share is taken.

## The rule

Where the rider holds a Snowsports School booking for the season, and the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season, the larger of the package's lesson bundle share and its lodging bundle share is taken off, and the two are never added together.

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season and the rider holds no Snowsports School booking for it, the package's lodging bundle share is taken off.

Where the rider holds a Snowsports School booking for the season and the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation for it, the package's lesson bundle share is taken off.

In any other case no share is taken off under this heading.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Lesson bundle share | Lodging bundle share | The larger of the two |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 15 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 per cent |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 15 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 per cent |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 10 per cent | 10 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 10 per cent | 5 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 0 per cent | 5 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent |

## The four combinations

| Snowsports School booking held for the season | Resort Lodging reservation held for the season | Share taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the larger of the package's two bundle shares |
| no | yes | the package's lodging bundle share |
| yes | no | the package's lesson bundle share |
| no | no | none under this heading |

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take a Performance Ski & Board Rental agreement standing at 400.00 USD when this heading is reached.

- The rider holds a school booking and the household a lodging reservation for the season: the larger of 10 per cent and 5 per cent is 10 per cent, so 40.00 USD comes off and 360.00 USD is left.
- The household holds a lodging reservation and the rider no school booking: 5 per cent comes off, leaving 380.00 USD.
- The rider holds a school booking and the household no lodging reservation: 10 per cent comes off, leaving 360.00 USD.
- Neither is held for the season: no share is taken off under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**Whose holding is whose.** The school booking read is the rider's own, and the lodging reservation read is the household's.
